name: Aquatic and Fishery Sciences PhD

english.toefl: 4.0 minimum;80 for tests beforeJanuary21,2026. Recommended4.5 or92 on older scale.
english.note: Central minimums; recommended IELTS7 or DET130. Admission below recommended scores requires1–2Academic English Program courses with additional fees. Programs can impose higher standards. Qualifying English-medium bachelor/master/doctoral degrees can satisfy policy with official documentation and full-duration campus/country residency. Official scores valid2years; MyBest/IELTSOneSkillRetake not accepted.

applicationFee.note: Central need/preparation-program waivers exclude F1/J1 applicants. A separate stacked-degree waiver concerns subsequent applications in approved pathways and is not a general first-PhD fee waiver.

documents: Two to four electronic recommendation letters
requirements.note: Secure a faculty sponsor before applying; applicants without sponsorship are unlikely to be admitted. Applicants without a master’s degree at entry should use the MS application and indicate their PhD intent; transition to PhD requires committee support. Optional extenuating-circumstances statement (500 words); no additional writing samples or publications accepted. Research statement addresses proposed research and preparation; personal statement covers rationale, goals and relevant skills.

detailsNote: The official November 15 deadline is undated; Fall 2027 is not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: For both domestic and international applicants; undated. Late/incomplete applications not considered.

timeline.decisions: Offers begin in March; all applicants hear before April 15 (annual schedule, year not specified).

funding.note: SAFS admits only students with confirmed funding for at least six to eight quarters; packages vary by sponsor and available RA/TA, fellowships, employer or external aid. Packages typically include stipend/salary, health insurance, tuition and some fees. This is not a full-PhD-duration guarantee; students pay remaining fees and must meet progress/work/enrollment conditions. Personal savings/loans do not count toward admission funding.
